name: verdikta-discover
description: Use when the owner wants or allows outside, independent or second-opinion work on a bounded task: hire or delegate a specialist, post a bounty, run a large batch in parallel (up to 20 technical claims or a 50-cell evidence grid), wants an outside review of a public artifact such as a code change, rubric, specification or proposal (up to 15 review items), needs something done by a person at a place or remotely (a real-world task with an evidence pack), asks whether outsourcing is worthwhile or which parts would need outside help, leaves outside help to your judgment, or wants to see what such a work order, bounty or evidence package would look like. Open it in a step of its own before fetching any page such a task names. Drafts a bounded work order with acceptance criteria and public market context. Needs no wallet, API key, registration, upload or spending. Not for routine lookups or checks the agent can finish itself.
